title: TMP Camera Surveillance Next 2.20.48
summary: Auto mode now abandons a frame-less mainstream quickly and falls through to balanced/secondstream/substream instead of retrying encoders on the dead profile.
changes: Add an eight-second first-frame timeout for automatic profile selection
Classify missing normalized media frames as a profile failure rather than an encoder failure
Skip copy/VAAPI/CPU retries on a frame-less profile and continue immediately with the next weaker profile
name: TMP Camera Surveillance Next v2.20.48
description: Fast automatic downgrade when the preferred profile produces no normalized media frames.
releaseNotes: Auto mode falls back to a weaker profile after eight seconds without first normalized media frames.
